⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Highly Recommended Stay in Paharganj!

I had such a wonderful experience staying at this hotel in Paharganj. It’s one of the best and most affordable places I’ve stayed at — clean rooms, fresh fragrance everywhere (unlike many other hotels around that smelled musty), and truly welcoming vibes.

The staff was very helpful and kind throughout my stay, and the owner was humble and genuinely caring. What impressed me most was their service — they even helped me check in at 3 AM without any hassle, which is rare to find these days.

Everything from cleanliness to comfort was just perfect. The room was cozy, peaceful, and smelled amazing. I really felt at home here.

If you’re visiting Delhi and looking for a budget-friendly yet comfortable and clean hotel in Paharganj, this is the place to stay! You’ll be treated like family here. 💖
negative_snippets:
I recently stayed at this hotel and had a mixed experience.
The room itself was clean and well-maintained, which I appreciated. However, the overall service was disappointing. The staff showed rude behavior and were not welcoming, which made the stay uncomfortable.
Additionally, basic toiletries were not provided in the room. Simple amenities like soap and other essential items were missing, which was inconvenient.
Because of the staff attitude and lack of basic facilities, I would not choose to book this hotel again.
